name: dynamic-tools-v1
description: Eval scenarios for DSL-driven dynamic tools (send_dynamic_card, compose_dynamic_email) and module-wrapper search. Run with evals/run_evals.py across sampling models.

items.judge_criteria: The card was delivered without error. The response should indicate a card titled 'Service Status' with two decorated-text rows: API Gateway online (styled as success) and Database degraded. DSL structure §[δ×2] should be respected (one section, two DecoratedText widgets, no invented extra widgets).

args.card_description: §[δ, Ƀ[ᵬ×2 Deployment summary card with two link buttons

items.judge_criteria: The DSL in card_description is malformed (unclosed brackets). The sampling-based DSL recovery should repair it to a valid structure (one section with a text widget and a two-button list) and the card should still be delivered without error, containing the deploy text and both buttons.

The tool-equipped sampling agent should produce exactly 3 card variations (Conservative, Enhanced, Creative/Styled) and deliver them to the chat space in a shared thread without error. All variations must keep the sprint content (14 stories shipped, 3 carried over) and valid DSL structure.

args.email_description: ε[ħ, τ×2, Ƀ] Weekly Status — Eval Harness

_items.text: The Langfuse evaluation harness is now wired into the dynamic tools.
Cross-model runs compare output quality, token usage, latency, and cost.

items.judge_criteria: A Gmail draft (not a send) was created without error, with subject 'Weekly Status — Eval Harness', a hero block, two text paragraphs matching the provided copy, and one button linking to Langfuse. Structure ε[ħ, τ×2, Ƀ] should be respected.

args.query: button widget with icon and click action

items.judge_criteria: The search returned up to 5 components from the wrapped card_framework.v2 module and the top results are genuinely button/interaction related (Button, ButtonList, OnClick, Icon), not unrelated widgets.
